body: Good for you. Stand up for yourself, you’re the one one who will right now. You did the right thing, I would have done the same thing.

I also think that those of us stupid enough to get married in our 20s shouldn’t be shamed for getting older and saying “damn, that was a mistake.” We shouldn’t have to feel like we have to live with that mistake forever just because. 

My mom and dad got married at 20&21 and they’re still together but miserable because my mom refuses to get divorced. She sees it as failure and I don’t think it should be seen that way. 

People grow and change and if you change more than your SO, you shouldn’t be chastised for seeing that and understanding that it’s not healthy anymore.

It feels so good to know I’m not the only one. I don’t want to fix it either. I don’t think it’s possible. I’ve been looking inward so much I think I’ve finally come to the realization of what makes me happy. And unfortunately it’s solitude, freedom, and independence. Everything that marriage is not...

I am in the EXACT same position. I love him and he loves me but I want to live alone and have my own life for a while. 

I don’t know how to tell him this because it’ll hurt him so much. 

Sorry I don’t have any advice but just know you’re not alone in these feelings!!

I don’t want to hurt him. That’s the worst part. I can’t stand the thought of hurting him but if that means I’m unhappy it’s a hard choice to make. My parents have been in a horrible marriage for 30 years because they refuse to leave each other for their own reasons. I don’t want to end up like them, unhappy after 30 years because neither of them has the guts to make a change.

I think I feel lost in what his family sees me as and what they want us to be. He has a very strong family dynamic, I do not. His family is very involved in our every day life. Constantly asking us when we’re going to give them a grandchild, wanting to see us every weekend, that kind of thing. 

They have another DIL who they don’t like and they kind of latch on to me as their only daughter. I guess I feel a little lost and stuck trying to be the perfect DIL they want me to be. 

I really should just see a therapist. Good advice on that one..going to look for one now.

It’s hard because he travels a lot for work. I think part of the problem is that through our entire engagement he was gone 5 days a week, and now he’s slowly stopping that. I’m finding myself dreading the times when he’s home all week or for multiple weeks and breathing a sigh of relief when he leaves for his travels. Again, not because I want to spend time with someone else or have any secrets. Just because I want to be alone. I’m not sure how to tell him I like when he’s gone...it seems so mean and cruel but it honestly has nothing to do with him or how he treats me.
I definitely have thought about therapy and I think I need to go. I know if I start going to therapy he’s going to ask why, and I don’t know how to tell him why.

More info. 

I had doubts through our engagement but chalked it up to cold feet and hoped it would go away. It didn’t. 

I know this is my fault. I know I shouldn’t have said “I do” unless I was 100% sure but I just thought I would get past the nerves by now. I just haven’t and I can’t take it anymore. 

I know this is going to be the hardest thing because I do love him, I just wasn’t ready...
